page.title: OurTaikoEdit · What you write is what you play
page.description: OurTaikoEdit is a cross-platform taiko chart editor: TJA code, a lane preview and an editable timeline kept in sync, live diagnostics and playtesting. For macOS and Windows.
hero.tagline: What you write is what you play.
hero.description: A cross-platform taiko chart editor. Write TJA on the left, watch the lane at the top right, edit the timeline below. It reads charts with the game’s own parser, so what you see is what you play.
hero.shotAlt: The OurTaikoEdit window: TJA code on the left, the lane preview at the top right and a timeline with three branches below it
features.title: Everything a chart needs.
features.sub: Code, lane and timeline stay in sync — edit wherever you like.
feature.viewsText: Select, move, copy and paste notes on the timeline, change their kind or drag a drumroll’s end — the code follows.
feature.parserText: Charts are read by TJAParser, the same parser the game and the website use, so the result never differs.
feature.diagnosticsText: Errors, warnings and hints are listed by severity, with explanations on hover.
feature.audioText: Edit while the song plays, see its waveform on the timeline, and choose from the game’s 21 hit sound sets.
feature.playtestText: Jump into a play scene from where you are or from the start, and play it yourself on the keyboard.
feature.branchesText: Normal, expert and master routes side by side. Add or remove branches, with measures numbered in play order.
feature.encodingText: Old charts in Shift_JIS, GB18030 and more open as they are, and are saved as UTF-8.
feature.languagesText: English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese, diagnostics included.
gallery.title: See every note.
gallery.sub: Branches, judgements and problems, clear at a glance.
gallery.branchAlt: The OurTaikoEdit timeline: three rows of notes for normal, expert and master, with the branch condition marked at measure 9
gallery.problemsAlt: The OurTaikoEdit window with the problems list open at the bottom and the faulty spots marked in the code
download.title: Start charting.
download.sub: Stable and Nightly builds are on GitHub Releases, or install with RhythmHub and stay updated.
download.rhythmhubText: The RhythmHub launcher lists OurTaikoEdit from version 1.0.5: install in one click, choose stable or daily builds, and it updates in the background.
download.firstRunMac: macOS: the app is not notarised yet, so the first launch is blocked; choose “Open Anyway” in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
download.firstRunWindows: Windows: in the SmartScreen prompt, choose “More info → Run anyway”.
